prompts.cup_r4: Generate a NEW independent isolated pixel-art coffee cup and saucer game sprite on true transparent background. Reference image is STYLE AND PIXEL SCALE ONLY, not an edit target. Look specifically at the blue-and-gold lantern immediately to the RIGHT of the white coffee cup in the reference: match that lantern's bold discrete pixel clusters, staircase silhouette, economical shading and strong square pixel size. The previous cup in reference is too fine: do not imitate it. Cup and saucer together should be designed as if authored on roughly a 32-pixel-wide by 24-pixel-high sprite grid, enlarged uniformly with square nearest-neighbor macro pixels. Cup body only about 16 logical pixels wide, rim ellipse about 14 pixels wide, saucer about 28 pixels wide. Every visible edge, highlight and shading step must use the SAME large square macro-pixel grid. Render at large resolution with obvious large square blocks, no fine subpixel marks. Ivory porcelain coffee cup with dark amber coffee, right handle open, complete saucer, look down 35 degrees, front view weak perspective to fit the desk. Limit ceramic shading to 4 broad connected ivory/beige/cool-gray clusters; coffee to 3 warm brown clusters. Large single-step highlights, thick stair-step rim, compact bold silhouette. No smooth curves, antialiasing, gradients, fine lines, glossy micro-highlights, dither, noise, decoration, text, halo, external cast shadow, table or other objects. Cup touches saucer naturally. Transparent safety margin. Must read like the reference lantern's coarse old console sprite, not an illustration with a pixel effect.
